usage: Used for a document, file, or paper record in everyday and workplace Cantonese. It is a very common noun and can be used in both speaking and writing.
Often appears with verbs like 睇, 整理, 交, and 攞, especially when talking about paperwork, applications, contracts, or office records.
Can refer to both physical papers and digital files depending on context. In business settings, it often means formal paperwork or supporting materials.
Learners should remember that 文件 is usually neutral and general, so it fits many practical situations without sounding too formal or technical.
